title: Her Irresistible Scent
details:
Frank (Rokco) the carpet installer is taking measurements of Sandra (Leah Hayes)'s bedroom when he notices her sexy panties under the bed. Aroused, he grabs them and gives them a little sniff, eventually shoving them into his pocket. When he goes to get Sandra to sign off on some paperwork later, however, she asks for a pen... causing him to reach into his pocket and accidentally reveal that he stole her panties!

Frank is mortified and apologizes profusely, but is surprised when Sandra seems rather amused. He's even MORE surprised when she starts coming onto him, offering to let him see the panties she's wearing right now! Of course he can't resist, which leads to cheeky fun for both of them.
